note: Temporary CI tolerances for known high/critical advisories, not production risk acceptance. Each record binds one advisory to one vulnerable package and expires; re-triage before expiry. See SECURITY.md SEC-06.

exceptions.rationale: Reached through expo-router -> query-string@7 URL query parsing on the Expo client (possible UI-thread DoS from a crafted deep link). Patched versions are ESM-only and incompatible with query-string 7; the fix arrives with Expo SDK 58, which awaits a user decision and device testing.
exceptions.followUp: SECURITY.md SEC-06; Expo SDK 58 upgrade decision

exceptions.rationale: zod 3.25.76 is not imported by application source; it is used transitively by @hookform/resolvers, convex-helpers (via @convex-dev/aggregate) and lint tooling. Fixed only in zod 4, which those consumers do not support yet. Reachability of oversized constrained collections not established.
